question: How does the all-pervading lord govern the five causes?
premises: Through Samanā the all-pervading lord presides over the five causes.
He is unsupported, lordly, endless, and sky-bodied.
inference: The eternal unsupported lord governs the fivefold causal system through Samanā.
uncertainties: The identity of the five causes is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Through her the all-pervading lord presides over the five causes. This unsupported, lordly, endless, sky-bodied one does so always.
